summary: Completed backend + frontend integration testing for Gestaltungsstudio on public preview URL, including one REAL AI generation, upload validation, guest isolation, draft caching, cart/checkout test-order flow, and responsive UI checks.
action_items: Optional hardening: remove fallback default in backend/studio/storage.py (INTEGRATION_PROXY_URL) to keep strict env-only fail-fast behavior.
critical_code_review_comments: REAL AI flow is functional: exactly one provider generation was executed and reached ai_status=ready with retrievable private ai_file_id.
Cache behavior is correct: repeat /preview on ready draft returned reused=true and did not decrement guest quota.
Auth isolation is correct for guest model: GuestB cannot access GuestA files, drafts, carts, or orders; missing/invalid/wrong token type returns 401.
Upload pipeline is robust: rights checkbox enforced, SVG/fake image/oversize bytes/oversize pixels rejected, EXIF stripped, blob stored in object storage with metadata-only Mongo record.
SAMPLE constraints/labels are present in API and UI (is_sample=true, production_approved=false, test checkout with payable_cents=0).
seed_data_creation: Created one seeded quota counter document for dedicated guest to validate 429 path; cleaned up seeded quota document after test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: One REAL AI generation has already been consumed in this run via backend test test_real_ai_generation_once_and_reuse_cached_preview. Frontend checks validated desktop(1920x1080), mobile(390x844 and 360x844), and tablet(768x1024) with no horizontal overflow. Local design resume and cart draft restore route were verified.
rca of the issue: No blocking backend/frontend defects reproduced in executed scope. Initial product-image false readings were timing-related (checked too early); re-check with wait confirmed all 4 sample images loaded with natural dimensions.
